records.jp: やっぱ、ここはなんだか不思議な感じがするなー。<CR>入るだけで身が引き締まるっていうか
records.en_original: This place has such a weird vibe... I feel all tense just being in here.
records.en_auxiliary: This place has such a weird vibe... I feel all tense just being in here.
records.en: This place has such a weird vibe... I feel<CR>all tense just being in here.

records.jp: そうなの？
records.en_original: Really?
records.en_auxiliary: Really?
records.en: Really?

records.jp: だって、放送室なんて放送委員以外入らないし。<CR>緊張しない？　ここに来ると
records.en_original: I mean, normal people usually can't enter the broadcasting room. Doesn't that make you feel nervous?
records.en_auxiliary: I mean, normal people usually can't enter the broadcasting room. Doesn't that make you feel nervous?
records.en: I mean, normal people usually can't enter the broadcasting room.<CR>Doesn't that make you feel nervous?

records.jp: あたしはワクワクする！　いろんなもの置いてあるし
records.en_original: No, it makes me feel excited! All the gear here is so cool!
records.en_auxiliary: No, it makes me feel excited! All the gear here is so cool!
records.en: No, it makes me feel excited! All the gear here is so cool!

records.jp: あはは、さすが勇希
records.en_original: Ahaha, of course it does.
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha, of course it does.
records.en: Ahaha, of course it does.

records.jp: この部屋、こんなにちゃんとしてるのに<CR>全然有効活用されてないと思うんだよね
records.en_original: It's a real shame we've got all this nice equipment that isn't getting used...
records.en_auxiliary: It's a real shame we've got all this nice equipment that isn't getting used...
records.en: It's a real shame we've got all this nice<CR>equipment that isn't getting used...

records.jp: 突然どうしたの？
records.en_original: What's gotten into you all of a sudden?
records.en_auxiliary: What's gotten into you all of a sudden?
records.en: What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

records.jp: 天啓が舞い降りたんだよ
records.en_original: I've just been struck by divine inspiration.
records.en_auxiliary: I've just been struck by divine inspiration.
records.en: Divine revelation descended upon me.

records.jp: んな大げさな……
records.en_original: ...Divine, huh?
records.en_auxiliary: ...Divine, huh?
records.en: ...Divine, huh?

records.jp: たしかに……
records.en_original: That's true...
records.en_auxiliary: That's true...
records.en: That's true...

records.jp: でしょ？　使えるものは<CR>使っていかないといけないと思うんだよね
records.en_original: Right? Things should be used, not just left to gather dust.
records.en_auxiliary: Right? Things should be used, not just left to gather dust.
records.en: Right? Things should be<CR>used, not just left to gather dust.

records.jp: で、具体的にどうするの？
records.en_original: So, what are you planning?
records.en_auxiliary: So, what are you planning?
records.en: So, what are you planning?

records.jp: ラジオしようよ！
records.en_original: That we use it ourselves, of course! We can make our own radio show!
records.en_auxiliary: That we use it ourselves, of course! We can make our own radio show!
records.en: That we use it ourselves, of course! We can make our own radio show!

records.jp: ラジ……え？
records.en_original: We can do what now?!
records.en_auxiliary: We can do what now?!
records.en: We can do what now?!

records.jp: ラジオだって。ほら、よくあるじゃん。<CR>今日も始まりましたFMなんたら～ってやつ
records.en_original: You heard me! "Welcome to Blah-Blah FM, the #1 hit music station!" That kinda thing!
records.en_auxiliary: You heard me! "Welcome to Blah-Blah FM, the #1 hit music station!" That kinda thing!
records.en: A radio show. You know, the usual.<CR>“FM Something-or-Other starts again today~”

records.jp: いや、それは分かってるけど！<CR>なんでラジオ？
records.en_original: I know what a radio show is! I was just wondering why you wanted to make one.
records.en_auxiliary: I know what a radio show is! I was just wondering why you wanted to make one.
records.en: I know what a radio show is! I was just wondering why<CR>you wanted to make one.

records.jp: 楽しそうじゃない？<CR>あたし、ちょっとやってみたかったんだよね
records.en_original: Doesn't it sound fun? I've always wanted to have my own show.
records.en_auxiliary: Doesn't it sound fun? I've always wanted to have my own show.
records.en: Doesn't it sound fun?<CR>I've always wanted to have my own show.

records.jp: まあ……ちょっと興味はあるかも
records.en_original: Hmm... Well, I can't say I'm not a little interested.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... Well, I can't say I'm not a little interested.
records.en: Hmm... Well, I can't say I'm not a little interested.

records.jp: お、いいね！　そう来なくちゃ
records.en_original: All right! Let's do this!
records.en_auxiliary: All right! Let's do this!
records.en: All right! Let's do this!

records.jp: うーん、でも、上手く喋れるかな……
records.en_original: Hmm... I dunno if I have a very good radio voice...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... I dunno if I have a very good radio voice...
records.en: Hmm... I dunno if I have a very good radio voice...

records.jp: 大丈夫だよ。どうせ聞いてるのは<CR>知り合いしかいないんだし
records.en_original: Don't worry about that! The only people who will listen to it are our friends, after all.
records.en_auxiliary: Don't worry about that! The only people who will listen to it are our friends, after all.
records.en: Don't worry about that! The only people who will<CR>listen to it are our friends, after all.

records.jp: それもそっか……
records.en_original: True...
records.en_auxiliary: True...
records.en: True...

records.jp: でも、何を話すの？
records.en_original: So... What should I say?
records.en_auxiliary: So... What should I say?
records.en: So... What should I say?

records.jp: そうだなぁ……
records.en_original: Hmm...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm...
records.en: Hmm...

records.jp: 最近あった嬉しいこと、とか？
records.en_original: You could talk about something that made you happy recently.
records.en_auxiliary: You could talk about something that made you happy recently.
records.en: You could talk about something that made you happy recently.

records.jp: 嬉しいこと……
records.en_original: Something that made me happy...
records.en_auxiliary: Something that made me happy...
records.en: Something that made me happy...

records.jp: そう。例えば……
records.en_original: Yeah. Like...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. Like...
records.en: Yeah. Like...

records.jp: 料理をアレンジしてみたら、うまくいって<CR>皆に好評でした！
records.en_original: "I cracked open an egg this morning and there were two yolks inside!"
records.en_auxiliary: "I cracked open an egg this morning and there were two yolks inside!"
records.en: “I tried adapting a dish, it went well,<CR>and everyone loved it!”

records.jp: ……それが最近あった嬉しいこと？
records.en_original: That was something that made you happy recently?
records.en_auxiliary: That was something that made you happy recently?
records.en: That was something that made you happy recently?

records.jp: そうだよ。こういう些細な幸せの積み重ねが<CR>人生を彩っていくんだよ
records.en_original: Yep. If you ask me, life is all about the small, happy moments like that.
records.en_auxiliary: Yep. If you ask me, life is all about the small, happy moments like that.
records.en: That is right. An accumulation of small happiness like this<CR>is what colors a person’s life.

records.jp: な、なるほど……
records.en_original: I-I see...
records.en_auxiliary: I-I see...
records.en: I-I see...

records.jp: ほら、愛央も試しに考えてみてよ！
records.en_original: So, c'mon! Your turn, Ao!
records.en_auxiliary: So, c'mon! Your turn, Ao!
records.en: So, c'mon! Your turn, Ao!

records.jp: 私？　私は――
records.en_original: O-okay... Let's see...
records.en_auxiliary: O-okay... Let's see...
records.en: O-okay... Let's see...

records.jp: 最近、なくしたと思ってた<CR>櫛がひょっこり出てきた……とか？
records.en_original: I found my comb that I thought I'd lost. Will that do?
records.en_auxiliary: I found my comb that I thought I'd lost. Will that do?
records.en: I found my comb that I<CR>thought I'd lost. Will that do?

records.jp: あー、いいね。<CR>そういうのだよ、そういうの
records.en_original: Ooh, of course! That's exactly the kind of thing I was talking about!
records.en_auxiliary: Ooh, of course! That's exactly the kind of thing I was talking about!
records.en: Ooh, of course! That's<CR>exactly the kind of thing I was talking about!

records.jp: みんなと友達になれたこと、かな
records.en_original: I'm happy that I became friends with all of you.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm happy that I became friends with all of you.
records.en: I'm happy that I became friends with all of you.

records.jp: 愛央、何か変な物でも食べた？
records.en_original: Whoa, Ao, are you feeling okay? Did you eat something weird?
records.en_auxiliary: Whoa, Ao, are you feeling okay? Did you eat something weird?
records.en: Whoa, Ao, are you feeling okay? Did you eat something weird?

records.jp: そんな真顔で聞かないでよ！<CR>本当に思ってるのに！
records.en_original: Cut it out! I'm trying to be honest here!
records.en_auxiliary: Cut it out! I'm trying to be honest here!
records.en: Cut it out! I'm trying<CR>to be honest here!

records.jp: ふふっ、冗談だよ冗談
records.en_original: Hehe, I'm just kidding!
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, I'm just kidding!
records.en: Hehe, I'm just kidding!

records.jp: なんか、他の人の嬉しかったこと聞くのっていいね。<CR>幸せのおすそ分けって感じで
records.en_original: I like hearing about things that make people happy. It makes me feel part of that happiness too.
records.en_auxiliary: I like hearing about things that make people happy. It makes me feel part of that happiness too.
records.en: There is something nice about hearing what made other people happy.<CR>It feels like they are sharing some of their happiness.

records.jp: それは……そうかも
records.en_original: Yeah... You're right.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah... You're right.
records.en: Yeah... You're right.

records.jp: 今度、みんなからもお便り募ってみよっか？
records.en_original: Why don't we get the others to share their stories too?
records.en_auxiliary: Why don't we get the others to share their stories too?
records.en: Why don't we get the others to share their stories too?

records.jp: あ、ラジオっぽい
records.en_original: Oh, just like real radio show hosts do!
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, just like real radio show hosts do!
records.en: Oh, just like real radio show hosts do!

records.jp: あはは、でしょ？<CR>勇希と愛央の雫世界ラジオ、近日放送開始！！
records.en_original: Exactly! The Yuki and Ao Show, coming to you live from Oasis!
records.en_auxiliary: Exactly! The Yuki and Ao Show, coming to you live from Oasis!
records.en: Ahaha, right?<CR>Yuki and Ao’s Droplet World Radio, coming soon!!

records.jp: ――ってね
records.en_original: Sounds cool, eh?
records.en_auxiliary: Sounds cool, eh?
records.en: Sounds cool, eh?
